<!-- pr-reviewer: 512a7a53d670842dfb5699443e479fc40dc27504 -->
**Review of head `512a7a53d`: clean.** The coordinator read the diff (one test file, +39/-14); a gate-runner that did not write the change ran it (main `23c472510` is an ancestor of the head).

- **The change.** `normalise_eol` turns CRLF into LF; `join_continuations` calls it before the join of the strings that continue with a backslash; the text of the guide page goes through it too. No assert and no stem changes. No product code changes.
- **Runs.** `docs_troubleshooting`: 2 passed (`troubleshooting_messages_still_exist_in_the_sources`, `join_continuations_accepts_crlf_line_ends`). With `crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs`, `flute_reach.rs` and the guide page changed to CRLF on the disk: 2 passed. clippy on the test binary: clean.
- **The pin can fail.** With the call of `normalise_eol` in `join_continuations` taken out, the new test fails: "CRLF continuation was not joined".

The reporter confirms on his checkout with `core.autocrlf=true` (#3619).
